phase_name: Inventory every measurement metric (corrected per audit round 7)
protocol_frozen_meaning: Phase 4 is an inventory task, not a preregistered experiment. The broader measurement/discrimination protocol (Phases 8-17) is not yet frozen.
scientific_results_note: Phase 4 produced a metric inventory. This is a measurement infrastructure artifact, not a discovery claim. M-008 is explicitly quarantined. No metric is SCIENTIFICALLY_ELIGIBLE.

audit_round_7_corrections_applied.removed_unsupported_passed_claims: Per audit: 'absence of a failed regeneration is not evidence of successful regeneration.' Removed PASSED from 37 metrics. Replaced with REGENERATED_AND_MATCHED with shared-context caveat.
audit_round_7_corrections_applied.added_provenance_declared_vs_verified: Every metric now has provenance.provenance_declared (location known) and provenance.provenance_verified (cryptographically verified). No metric has provenance_verified=true.
audit_round_7_corrections_applied.added_input_hashes: SHA-256 hashes for computation source, spec source, committed results, gold set source, synonym map. Entity pool hash requires runtime computation (noted).
audit_round_7_corrections_applied.m008_n_resamples_clarified: M-008 uses 200 resamples (hardcoded at bootstrap_statistics.py:489), NOT the global 500. This does NOT explain the discrepancy.
audit_round_7_corrections_applied.m008_determinism_traced: point_estimate = metric_fn(original_sample). M-008's metric_fn uses a module-level RNG (rng_fp = _random.Random(seed) created once at line 480). Deterministic under fixed inputs. Discrepancy must come from input change (all_entities, gold, m_synonym, or _score_f1_dr91).
audit_round_7_corrections_applied.epistemic_ladder_applied: HISTORICAL → PROVENANCE_DECLARED → REPRODUCTION_UNTESTED → REGENERATED_AND_MATCHED → SCIENTIFICALLY_ELIGIBLE (+ QUARANTINED). No metric is SCIENTIFICALLY_ELIGIBLE.
audit_round_7_corrections_applied.m008_language_tightened: M-008 is 'the current preregistered/blocking measurement for false-positive-floor assessment under MC-5', NOT a mathematical definition of discrimination.
audit_round_7_corrections_applied.phase_8_17_split: Blocked: scientific verdicts using M-008. Potentially allowed: infrastructure work not using M-008 as evidence.
audit_round_7_corrections_applied.machine_test_added: tests/test_phase4_regeneration_accounting.py — 5 tests verifying no unsupported PASSED claims, no scientific eligibility without independent regen, M-008 quarantine, provenance distinction.

inventory_summary.note: 37 metrics are REGENERATED_AND_MATCHED under a single shared-context run of bootstrap_all_metrics. This is NOT 37 independent regeneration proofs. No metric is SCIENTIFICALLY_ELIGIBLE. Moving to SCIENTIFICALLY_ELIGIBLE requires independent per-metric regeneration.

epistemic_ladder.current_state: 37 at REGENERATED_AND_MATCHED (shared context), 1 at QUARANTINED (M-008). 0 at SCIENTIFICALLY_ELIGIBLE.
epistemic_ladder.governing_principle: Absence of a failed regeneration is not evidence of successful regeneration.

m008_quarantine.n_resamples_note: M-008 hardcodes 200 resamples (bootstrap_statistics.py:489), NOT the global 500. Both committed and fresh runs use 200 for M-008. This does NOT explain the discrepancy.

determinism.point_estimate_computation: metric_fn(original_sample) — computed on the ORIGINAL sample, NOT a resample
determinism.m008_closure_rng: rng_fp = _random.Random(seed) created ONCE at module load (line 480), shared across point_estimate and all resamples
determinism.implication: Discrepancy must come from a change in: all_entities content/ordering, gold content/ordering, m_synonym behavior, or _score_f1_dr91. The investigation must identify which.

m008_quarantine.what_m008_measures_precise: M-008 is the current preregistered/blocking measurement for false-positive-floor assessment. Under MC-5, an FP floor above 5% blocks discovery claims. This is a policy threshold, not a mathematical definition of discrimination.

phase_8_17_impact.blocked: Any scientific verdict that consumes M-008 as an authoritative measurement. No scientific verdict may be generated using M-008 until reconciliation.
potentially_allowed: matcher harness construction (does not use M-008 as evidence)
phase_8_17_impact.principle: The project should not freeze useful measurement infrastructure merely because one metric is quarantined. But no scientific verdict may use M-008 until reconciliation.
